instrument.join: Same DBOS join as packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/routines/routine-last-fire.ts readRoutineLastFires: dbos.operation_outputs JOIN dbos.workflow_status ON workflow_uuid, w.name='routineFire', o.function_name='system:gitnexus-reindex', first superjson input = 'rt_papercusp_gitnexus_reindex'.
instrument.windowSql: SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE (o.output::jsonb->'json'->'diagnostics'->'dependencySnapshot'->>'status')='fresh'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE (...status) IS DISTINCT FROM 'fresh'), string_agg(DISTINCT w.executor_id, ','), string_agg(DISTINCT w.application_version, ','), string_agg(DISTINCT o.output::jsonb->'json'->'diagnostics'->>'maintenanceMode', ',') FROM dbos.operation_outputs o JOIN dbos.workflow_status w ON w.workflow_uuid=o.workflow_uuid WHERE o.completed_at_epoch_ms >= epoch('2026-10-18 07:30Z')*1000 AND o.function_name='system:gitnexus-reindex' AND w.name='routineFire' AND (w.inputs::jsonb->'json'->>0)='rt_papercusp_gitnexus_reindex'
instrument.gapSql: lag() over completion time across the last 96h; rows with gap > 90 minutes listed.

conclusion: Genuine 48h deployed freshness is demonstrated: 55 consecutive hourly routine fires over 54h on the deployed bg-host, every one reporting the first-party import snapshot fresh against its recorded 24h selector ceiling, with GitNexus analyze disabled and no errors. This closes the D-023 '48h deployed freshness' gap; it is not a benefit or usefulness claim.
limits: Fresh means within the 24h test-selector ceiling. Observed ages reach ~20h because the deployed refresh age is 20h. That age is too stale for snapshot-served code-intel answers (P-040 root cause); the in-tree change to a 45-minute refresh age is not yet deployed and is not measured here.
Earlier gaps (2026-10-17, 2026-10-18 up to 07:35Z) are outside the claimed window and are not explained here.
The real gate-selector log, the finished-distribution exclusion and final shipment remain separate P-042 obligations under D-023.
